Using the wheelchair - Getting into the wheelchair • LOCK the brakes! • Fold up the footplates and swing sway. • Stand with back of leg against the seat and press down on armrest. • Lower and place foot on footplates. • Pay attention to keep the heel clear of the front casters. Getting out of the wheelchair • LOCK the brakes! • Fold up the footplates and swing sway. • Make sure walking aids(if needed) is ready. • Slightly bend trunk forwards, standing up by pressing down on the armrest
